login.heading: Sign in
login.lead: Enter your Novikontas email. We send a link — no password to remember.
login.sentLead: If that address is recognised, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

errors.expired: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.domain: Only Novikontas email addresses can sign in.
errors.inactive: That account is not active. Contact the quality team.
errors.missing: That link was incomplete. Request a new one.
errors.state: That sign-in attempt expired or came from a different browser. Try again.
errors.google_failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Try again, or use a sign-in link.
errors.google_disabled: Google sign-in is not enabled on this deployment.

watch.graceLead: You missed last week. Log a suggestion before noon today and it counts.

form.heading: This week's suggestion
form.lead: One a week. It does not need to be large — a fix that saves someone ten minutes counts.
form.title: In one line, what should change?
form.titlePlaceholder: Bridge simulator briefing room needs a second whiteboard
form.body: What is the problem, and what would you do?
form.bodyPlaceholder: Describe what happens now, who it affects, and what you would change.
form.anonymousHint: Reviewers will not see your name. Your identity is still recorded, and any access to it is logged.
form.quotaReached: You have already logged this week's suggestion.

mine.heading: My log
mine.lead: Every suggestion you have logged, newest first.
mine.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this suggestion? This week's slot opens up again.

detail.revealWarn: This is recorded in the audit log.

board.heading: Board
board.lead: What colleagues have suggested, and what has come of it.

ranks.heading: Rank list
ranks.lead: Scored on what gets accepted and implemented, not on volume.
ranks.hiddenNames: Names are hidden on the staff view.
ranks.hiddenMisses: Missed weeks are only visible to administrators.
ranks.closed: The rank list is not open to staff right now.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.remindersHint: Friday evening, and Monday morning if the week is still open.
settings.statusUpdatesHint: Email me when one of my suggestions moves.

admin.queueLead: Oldest first. A decision is owed within {{days}} working days.
admin.reasonRequired: A written reason is required for this decision.
